slides.title: AI News Claude-Assisted Riemann Proof The proof passed
slides.text: AI News Claude-Assisted Riemann Proof The proof passed independent formal verification - potentially resolving one of mathematics’ most famous problems. The proof was released in Lean, rather than a conventional paper. Subsequent reports described independent checks confirming both the mathematical statement and the proof’s correctness. An official Clay Mathematics Institute recognition not done yet It was posed in 1859 by German mathematician Bernhard Riemann It is a $1 million Millennium Prize Problem "All nontrivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function lie on the line with real part 1/2" The Riemann zeta function links an infinite sum over integers to a product over all primes, which is why it reveals the hidden structure of prime numbers ζ(s) = 1 + 1/2^s + 1/3^s + …, extended to nearly the whole complex plane Primes look random, and their distribution is tied to these zeros Trillions of zeros were checked by computer, but that is not a proof. https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/the-ai-riemann-hypothesis-proof-is-almost-certainly-true-independent-mathematicians-attest/ https://www.newscientist.com/article/2600134-anthropic-mathematician-claims-ai-assisted-proof-of-the-riemann-hypothesis/

slides.title: Dashboard vs Chat Dashboard vs Chat Can you
slides.text: Dashboard vs Chat Dashboard vs Chat Can you  fly a plane using AI chatbot instead of a real dashboard? The answer is no. Similarly you can NOT use a chatbot to manage multiple multi-agent projects. You need a dashboard. Or multiple dashboards. Dashboard Cockpit: Fleet overview: the status of each agent (running, idle, blocked, failed), queue depth, and the error rate per agent. Cost and tokens: spend per agent, model and task, plus budget burn. Latency and reliability: P95 latency, tool failure rates, and retries or loops. Run drill-down: a trace waterfall for one run, showing the parent and child agents and each tool call. Quality: eval scores, user feedback, and guardrail triggers. Governance: pending approvals and an audit log. Your SOX and SOC 2 interest fits here. Alerts on thresholds such as cost spikes, stuck runs and error bursts. Buttons for pause, kill, approve and retry, backed by an API on your orchestrator. A chat box beside the panels. It would read the same telemetry and answer questions like "why did agent X stall?", and it would be an add-on to the dashboards, not a replacement for them. Agents Tracing - Trajectories, OpenTelemetry https://www.morphllm.com/agent-tracing https://openlit.io/glossary/opentelemetry-genai-semantic-conventions

slides.title: Emacs as a Multi-Agent Cockpit Emacs as a
slides.text: Emacs as a Multi-Agent Cockpit Emacs as a Multi-Agent Cockpit An experienced C++ programmer uses Emacs to manage multiple multi-agent projects, turning his familiar editor into a customizable monitoring and control cockpit. Instead of relying on chatbot conversations alone, he builds persistent views that keep agent activity visible across projects. AI-generated Emacs Lisp helps him create and adapt tools without building a separate web frontend. Buffers and windows can display agent status, logs, task queues, and errors, while commands provide project-specific controls. This approach combines monitoring, investigation, and intervention in one workspace. Its main value is flexibility: the interface evolves with the projects, although shared dashboards, rich charts, and auditing may require additional infrastructure.

slides.title: Agent Tracing Tools Compared Agent Tracing Tools Compared
slides.text: Agent Tracing Tools Compared Agent Tracing Tools Compared OpenLLMetry (Traceloop) : Built on OpenTelemetry with gen_ai.* extensions. Auto-instruments OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain and vector DBs, and exports to any OTel backend. Apache 2.0, vendor-neutral SDK. Langfuse: Built on OpenTelemetry. Nested agent traces via the LangChain/LangGraph handler or the framework-agnostic SDK. MIT core, self-host or cloud, unit-based billing. Arize Phoenix : Built on OpenTelemetry plus OpenInference. Parent-child spans across agent, LLM and tool steps, with full I/O. Elastic License 2.0, free to self-host, no event caps. Braintrust: Own SDK, OTel-compatible. Nested agent spans, with wrappers for OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph and CrewAI. Closed source, cloud only, eval-first. LangSmith: Own SDK, with OTel ingest supported. First-party LangGraph support, and one trace is one full agent run. Closed source, cloud, deepest LangChain fit. Laminar : OpenTelemetry-native. Transcript/reader view and chat-with-trace, and it traces Claude Agent SDK sub-agents via a Rust proxy. Open source, self-host or cloud. OpenAI Agents SDK : Built-in tracer with pluggable processors. Captures generations, tool calls, handoffs and guardrails, and is on by default for the Traces dashboard. Tied to the SDK, and you can fan out to other tools via processors.

slides.title: AI News Nvidia's AVO Lifts ARC-AGI-3 Score Nvidia
slides.text: AI News Nvidia's AVO Lifts ARC-AGI-3 Score Nvidia reported that Claude Opus 5 went from about 30% on its own to a perfect 100.00 RHAE on ARC-AGI-3's public set once it ran inside its AVO agent system (Aug 21). AVO = Agentic Variation Operators ARC-AGI-3 public set - uses unfamiliar game-like environments with no stated rules or goals The model alone falls short. AVO adds persistent memory, supervision and an inspect, plan, implement and evaluate loop Nvidia first built AVO to optimize GPU kernels So we see again that the system around a model can matter as much as the model https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.24517 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5Ni98RYmT-0 - video

slides.text: AI News Anthropic - Multi-Agent "telephone game" Anthropic's experiment (January 2026) - split agents by software dev. role: planner, implementer, tester, reviewer They found that the agents spent more tokens on coordination than on the actual work . Anthropic calls this a " telephone game ", where each handoff degrades fidelity . A common Claude Code and Codex setup splits work by role too: - One might write the fix, - the other could review it, - and a person coordinates the handoff https://x.com/akshay_pachaar/status/2126292505826398508 https://claude.com/resources/articles/building-multi-agent-systems-when-and-how-to-use-them

slides.title: AI News Gemini Agents Cut Quantum Costs Teams
slides.text: AI News Gemini Agents Cut Quantum Costs Teams of Gemini 4 agents cut a fusion-simulation circuit's cost 11.8x. Its memory fell from 5,650 to 4,338 error-corrected qubits. Independent agent teams worked on 5 known algorithms. They met at a virtual conference every 4 hours. Gains were 8x (light-sensitive molecule), 2.5x (cytochrome P450), 2.57x (Grover) and 290x (arcsin routine). The circuits are too large to test today, so Lean proved each result correct. These are resource estimates, not hardware runs https://deepmind.google/blog/finding-faster-quantum-algorithms-with-agents-and-formal-verification SELFWRITE - Self-Editing 27B Model https://www.alphaxiv.org/abs/2611.29513 "Recursive Self-Editing: LLMs Program Their Own Weight Edits for Self-Improvement" Based on Qwen3.8-27B. A model writes code that edits its own weights, with no gradients, optimizer or larger teacher model. Each round the model reviews its reasoning on fresh math problems and inspects its weights and activations in a Python session. It then writes a low-rank edit. A hidden gate set tests each edit, and the best improving edit is merged. After 5 rounds, held-out accuracy rose from 76.30% to 77.75% (avg@4) and from 82.60% to 84.80% (pass@4). https://www.aiinsiders.net/article/a-language-model-writes-its-own-weight-edits-no-gradients

slides.title: Cognition - SWE-2.1 model and Devin Bots Cognition
slides.text: Cognition - SWE-2.1 model and Devin Bots Cognition - SWE-2.1 model Cognition, a US startup valued at about $48 billion. CEO Scott Wu SWE-2.1 - a coding and agent model, RL-trained on  top of Kimi K3 It roughly doubles SWE-2 on Terminal-Bench 4.1, to 50.0 Cognition says it adds stronger security skills https://cognition.com/blog/swe-2-1 Cognition Devin Bots Devin Bots = AI Team Managers Devin Bots are persistent agents with memory that lead teams of Devin coding agents in parallel. It plans, delegates, reviews and brings humans only decisions. Example: one Devin Bot ran an Android app project for 44 days, merging 1,134 pull requests, writing 344,651 lines of Kotlin and closing 1,217 tickets, according to Cognition. Available online at devin.ai Bots work in Slack, iMessage, phone calls and the web app. - Problem: single Devin sessions handle one task and need human babysitting. - Solution: give a Bot an outcome to own. Competing with OpenAI's Dots and Anthropic's Duet. https://devin.ai/bots https://devin.ai/blog/introducing-devin-bots https://docs.devin.ai/work-with-devin/bots

slides.title: AI News Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B: agentic coding
slides.text: AI News Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B: agentic coding in 5.9 GB PrismML released Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B, a ternary-weight model It is built on Alibaba's Qwen3.8 27B It has only 5.9 GB footprint Much stronger agentic coding, multi-turn tool use and multi-step task execution Built for agents that work with private files and tools on-device PrismML calls it the strongest model of its memory size for agentic work Small enough for a laptop or phone-class hardware https://prismml.com/news/bonsai-2-5-27b Coding agents moved the bottleneck to code review Anthropic's Claude Code team more than doubled merged PRs from June to September 2026 while reverts fell over 40% Agents wrote the first draft of over 40% of PRs in September, up from 17% in March. Merged PRs hit 1.3 Billion in a year. Problem: Faros AI telemetry shows that under high AI adoption, median review time is up 441%. Bugs are up 54%, though Faros counts them per PR, not per developer. PRs merged with no review are up 31%. Solution: Anthropic uses layered checks, with human approval scaled by risk. It published six or seven layers, depending on how you count https://github.blog/news-insights/octoverse https://claude.dev/blog/solving-code-review-at-anthropic https://claude.com/resources/articles/introducing-claude-ship https://faros.ai/blog/ai-code-quality-senior-engineer-review-burden https://www.llmwatch.com/p/fast-alone-slow-together-how-to-unblock

slides.title: Escaping Negativity Bias How to Overcome Negativity Bias
slides.text: Escaping Negativity Bias How to Overcome Negativity Bias Daily Practices - by Tatyana Chernigovskaya Problem: negativity bias and chronic threat-monitoring make the brain notice deficits faster than opportunities Solution: .. redirect attention to what already exists .. practice specific bodily gratitude .. Calm the nervous system with long exhales .. Build self-worth through kept promises .. Use the language of abundance .. look after sleep, movement and diet .. Take responsibility for your own state .. choose supportive people Tatyana Chernigovskaya Brain Wiring for Abundance (Summary) Abundance is a brain state built by daily practice, not luck or circumstance Neuroplasticity - small repeated actions can rewire perception. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=10G_bxPunlM Tatyana Chernigovskaya
